2609.30226.title: PoEM: Predicting RL Outcomes from Existing Policies
2609.30226.paper_summary: Foundation models are post-trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to maximize specific rewards, such as human alignment, correctness, or instruction following. This post-training process is computationally intensive, sometimes unstable, and has to be run from scratch every time the reward model changes or when we want to combine multiple rewards. We hence ask: given a new reward function, is it possible to predict the RL outcomes without actually running RL on it? We answer this in the affirmative by introducing PoEM, a framework to predict the outputs of RL on a new reward function using a set of models already post-trained on other rewards. First, we show that if the new reward function can be written as a linear combination of existing ones, then the new policy in log-space can be written as a linear combination of the existing log-policies. Surprisingly, even in cases where the rewards are not linearly connected, we observe that often log-policies from RL training span an approximately low-rank subspace across rewards. To our benefit, the weighting coefficients for this combination can be estimated using only the reward or basis policy outputs on the samples. We turn these observations into an algorithm that takes post-trained models and a new reward function, and approximates the target RL policy without actually running any additional RL training. We experimentally validate our approach across synthetic and real rewards, spanning both text and image modalities.
2609.30226.paper_summary_zh: 基礎模型經過強化學習（RL）的後訓練，以最大化特定的獎勵，例如人類對齊、正確性或遵循指令。這一後訓練過程計算密集，有時不穩定，並且每當獎勵模型變更或我們想要結合多個獎勵時，都必須從頭開始運行。因此，我們提出問題：給定一個新的獎勵函數，是否可以在不實際運行 RL 的情況下預測 RL 的結果？我們的回答是肯定的，通過引入 PoEM，一個框架來預測在新獎勵函數上 RL 的輸出，使用一組已經在其他獎勵上進行後訓練的模型。首先，我們展示如果新的獎勵函數可以寫成現有獎勵的線性組合，那麼新的政策在對數空間中可以寫成現有對數政策的線性組合。令人驚訝的是，即使在獎勵並非線性連接的情況下，我們也觀察到，RL 訓練中的對數政策通常跨獎勵範圍內展現出大約低秩的子空間。對我們有利的是，這一組合的加權係數可以僅通過樣本上的獎勵或基礎政策輸出來估計。我們將這些觀察轉化為一個算法，該算法接受後訓練模型和一個新的獎勵函數，並在不實際運行任何額外的 RL 訓練的情況下，近似目標 RL 政策。我們在合成和真實獎勵上實驗性地驗證了我們的方法，涵蓋文本和圖像模態。
